title: docs(pm-dispatch): escalation discipline — batch decisions, no per-item confirmations
body:
Maintainer feedback, 2026-08-25, verbatim and untranslated: 「不要不停的弹出来让我确认,很浪费时间。这个也应该更新 skills」.

Adds one six-line rule block to `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, placed beside the auto-adjudication lane it extends:

1. **Directional authorization covers the whole chain** — after 「接受你的建议」/「帮我合并」-class instructions, the seat executes conflict resolution, labels, retries, queueing and closeout without per-item re-asking.
2. **Decisions batch** — ≤5 per batch, one line each with a recommended default; one word of assent executes the whole batch.
3. **Interim states stay off the maintainer's screen** — rate-limit/retry mechanics go to the seat post and triggers; reports only at milestones, real blockers, or when asked.
4. **Reversible defaults run on a veto window** — declared then executed, rolled back on objection; human-floor items (releases, ceilings, contract widenings) still need explicit words but batch too.

Verification: `check-skill-line-ratchet` green — 1005 lines (ceiling 1005, headroom 0), all six new lines ≤120 bytes; `check-skill-id-lint` 22 files clean.

Governed surface (`.claude/**`): opened as draft; landing under the same 2026-08-25 authorization pattern, with this PR body carrying the ruling.
